rules.initialization: No schema, dependency, token, TTL, cookie, runtime configuration or role migration. AuthService owns a WeakMap keyed by actual request object; binding includes corporation/sessionID/token hash/userID/provider identity, phase only, no AuthUser/member payload/Root/roles/capabilities. First online revalidate/upsert retained. Reuse does not repeat upsert. Existing protected64/public16/member32 reservations and only-inflight directory coalescing unchanged. Error deletes proof; original App onResponse releases proof. Optional context leaves all unscoped callers on original online path.
rules.dateAndPermission: Both initial/current findSession and Acceptance business-session checks remain, with current local active/employed/session/role/capabilities. Local errors fail closed. Last external successful handler check may cover later external change unknown locally only in this phase; next actual request is online, even identical client x-request-id/token. Handler helper explicitly requests fresh; remote-workflow paths are excluded. No claim of globally linearizable/zero-window revocation.
rules.expectation: Original auth unit/rate/concurrency/QR/session tests plus new phase/context cases pass. Same-request admission avoids duplicate external lookup, handler is fresh, response local-only; different actual request/sameID and switched sessions cannot reuse. Failure proof not retained, explicit fresh and release require online reads, local roles reload without old upsert and logout invalidates. Native signed same-valid-session role withdrawal is tested using original Root revokeRole and an independently retained warehouse role, not a Lab switch.

rules.initialization: Existing dependency callbacks accept optional trusted request context; server forwards only access/sourcing. Original current member-module write and PMC/Root guards remain. Admission guards can reuse their phase; original route actor point is fresh, successful sensitive preSerialization uses handler external proof but reloads local auth/Root then original redactor. Without an eligible handler proof, original online path is retained. rules.dateAndPermission: Explicit pilot whitelist: ordinary supplier profile/history and native maintenance/batch routes; sourcing ordinary case/list/metadata/history/catalog/analysis reads and pure-DB IE quote, management decision, budget correction, return, finance and exception commands. Create/correction/images, owner approval/contract rendering, styles, transfer/reprice/contract refresh, downloads/exports/Lab/other domains remain original fresh paths because they may wait remotely then write. This is a disclosed narrowing, not a claim that all sensitive workflows are migrated. Original attachment final authorization is excluded. Current local permission failure after commit is error/unknown result, never fake200/rollback.
rules.expectation: Actual buildApp+AuthService+PostgresAuthStore native supplier and IE quote commits tolerate subsequent controlled directory failure with only admission+handler2 external lookups and no post-commit lookup. Next request with same clientID fails online. Native IE same body/key replay returns original receipt and one native quote. Native audited disable after commit returns401, leaves saved row and performs no stale upsert. Native local session-read fault after commit returns500/no payload and keeps one row. Native post-read merch role withdrawal retains valid warehouse session and redacts bank/address. Dedicated pure PMC is truly logged in with exact[pmc] role and non-Root authority, can read approved supplier data but cannot write.
